purpose: Correct the native XGTC OMCI business T-CONT release path using this TYFZA1 board original DAL/AAL, not loss-sync recovery or another board SDK.

primary_evidence.business_delete: 1ms burst wait, AAL mask3 (Alloc-ID and OMCI enable); no global flush. A PLOAM-enabled entry is retained without a hardware write; otherwise invalidate Alloc-ID and clear OMCI enable.

fixed: Remove the unwarranted 0x4004 T-CONT flush and completion wait from all OMCI business table submissions, including the initial empty table.
Separate OMCI release from full initialization: respect PLOAM ownership instead of clearing the PLOAM enable bit.
Use usleep_range(1000,1100) for the factory burst wait, avoiding HZ=100 msleep rounding.
Report indirect table address, command and status on an actual timeout; continue returning the original error.

verification.before_fix: Saved production path_program with modeled non-completing flush returns -110 for an empty XGTC snapshot and writes command0x81000000 to0x4004. This demonstrates the erroneous dependency, not the peer hardware exact timeout location.
verification.stock_native: Four release comparisons (XG-PON/XGS-PON, PLOAM off/on) match table values and MMIO writes. Actual stock DAL and AAL instructions executed; indirect completion, locks and delays modeled.
verification.production_path: Existing GEM-direction regression extended for empty/add/replace, PLOAM release ownership, OMCC retention, unchanged0x4004 and real error propagation. GPON checks remain included because the function is shared.
verification.build_isolation: Current overlay sources/headers compiled with existing Kbuild flags into isolated outputs. Shared OpenWrt build sources and objects were not replaced.

oam_configuration: The existing XGPON startup branch starts pon-omcid and does not consume config oam line0_oam; adding the supplied5585F section does not affect this mapping path.
unchanged: Concurrent user files and OpenWrt submodule changes
